svg.title: Invoice sending: UBL invoice routes
svg.desc: Sending journey generated from the editable Draw.io source. The customer or ERP provides a UBL invoice, explicitly chooses the sender platform and indicates the recipient platform, then chooses an eligible certificate where required. Readiness checks the selected platform pair before sending. Private exchange, direct SPFE submission and proposed private-platform interconnection through SPFE keep their action results separate. Dashed recipient-access boxes are context outside sending. The local product generates any required recipient PDF.

g.text: Solid arrows: sending steps · Dashed arrows: observations / conditional context · Red dashed frame: TBC · E: blocked or uncertain work; see E recovery note below.

separately from the UBL action. Never send this
ERP owns issuance. Coordinate a required faithful copy with issuance, independently of private delivery success (OUT-Q03).
If the recipient platform is omitted
E · If sending is blocked or uncertain
Hold the affected action, preserve known results and return an owned next step. Reconcile before retry; do not switch platforms automatically.
UBL = Universal Business Language in XML format. Detailed sending rules and PDF applicability: SPEC-SEI-023 / PRD-SEI-246.
